prompt: Analyze the root cause of the failures in RPT-0009.

text: The throughput drop coincides with a link-down on the lab switch, while the DUT logged nothing in that window. TC-PERF-003 also failed once on 2.0.4 (Oct 2); checking whether that was the same port.

Two independent causes: one in the lab, one in the firmware.

| Cluster | Category | Key evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Lab switch port flap during the throughput test | environment · high | SW-01 `Gi1/0/7` down at the dip [[ev:{{test_run:TC-PERF-003}}/log/switch-syslog/7]]; DUT syslog clean in the window; same flap failed this test on 2.0.4 on Oct 2 [[ev:RUN-0023/log/switch-syslog/8]]; open lab ticket LAB-311 [[ev:TB-01/doc/docs/lab-notes.md#2026-09-29]] |
| mesh-agent memory leak → OOM | product_bug · high | free memory falls ≈ 17.5 MB/h per mesh-agent lifetime, flat on 2.0.4 [[ev:RUN-0040/check/mem_trend]]; `Out of memory: Killed process 1201 (mesh-agent)` [[ev:{{test_run:TC-END-004}}/log/dut-syslog/222]]; mesh-agent is new in 2.1.0 [[ev:TB-01/doc/docs/firmware/2.1.0.md#new-features]] |

The catalog check reports −4 483 kB/h over the whole run because mesh-agent is respawned after the kill; fitted up to the kill the leak is ≈ −17.5 MB/h [[ev:{{test_run:TC-END-004}}/metric/mem_free_kb/1791442330]]. Saving the analysis to the report.

args.summary_md:
- **Lab switch port flap during the throughput test** (environment, high): re-run TC-PERF-003, no firmware bug.
- **mesh-agent memory leak leads to OOM** (product bug, high): ticket to the mesh-agent team.

clusters.title: Lab switch port flap during the throughput test
clusters.root_cause: SW-01 port Gi1/0/7 (the SRV-01 uplink) went down for about 2 s exactly when iperf3 throughput dropped to 0. The DUT logged nothing in that window. The same flap failed this test on fw 2.0.4 on Oct 2, and the lab log has an open ticket (LAB-311) for this port.
clusters.recommendation: Re-run TC-PERF-003 once LAB-311 is fixed. Do not file a firmware bug.

clusters.title: mesh-agent memory leak leads to OOM
clusters.root_cause: On 2.1.0 free memory falls about 17.5 MB/h during each mesh-agent lifetime, while it stays flat on 2.0.4. After 9 h 40 m the kernel OOM killer stopped mesh-agent (PID 1201, 171 MB resident). mesh-agent is new in 2.1.0.
clusters.recommendation: Ticket to the mesh-agent team (draft created).

args.cluster_title: mesh-agent memory leak leads to OOM
args.title: mesh-agent leaks ~17.5 MB/h; OOM-killed after 9 h 40 m on 2.1.0
args.body_md:
## Summary
On fw 2.1.0, free memory falls about 17.5 MB/h during the 12 h endurance test (TC-END-004) until the kernel OOM killer stops mesh-agent after 9 h 40 m. On 2.0.4 memory stays flat.

## Evidence
- ev:{{test_run:TC-END-004}}/log/dut-syslog/222 (Out of memory: Killed process 1201 (mesh-agent))
- ev:{{test_run:TC-END-004}}/metric/mem_free_kb/1791442330 (6 483 kB free just before the kill)
- ev:RUN-0040/check/mem_trend (2.0.4 baseline, flat)

## Expected
Flat free memory over 12 h, as on 2.0.4.

text: Analysis saved to {{report_id}}, and a ticket draft is ready for the mesh-agent leak (stored only, nothing was sent). Recommendation: re-run TC-PERF-003 after the lab fixes SW-01 `Gi1/0/7`; no firmware bug for that one.
